err.control_off: An admin hasn't switched this Mission control on.
err.control_value: That value is outside what an admin allows for this Mission control.
err.control_wait: This Mission control was changed a moment ago. Try again in a few minutes.
err.control_not_set: This Mission control already uses the config value.
err.control_config: A Mission control here is unknown, or has a minimum above its maximum.
err.setting_grant_department: Each Mission controls grant needs a department key of Config.Departments (such as sast).
err.setting_grant_grant: Each Mission controls grant needs either minGrade (that grade and up) or grades (only those), not both.
mc.control_desc.cooldownScale: Multiplies every mission's cooldown, one number per mission type, for the whole server (0 = no cooldown).
mc.control_desc.abandonCooldown: Seconds an officer waits after abandoning a run or going down on one, for the whole server (0 = none).
mc.control_desc.noRepeat: Off lets the same mission come up twice in a row, for the whole server.
mc.control_desc.hourlyCap: Completed missions per officer per hour, for the whole server.
mc.control_desc.dailyCap: Completed missions per officer per day, for the whole server (0 = no cap).
sup.controls.subtitle: Change the rules an admin opened to supervisors. Every change needs a reason and is in the audit log.
sup.controls.self_note: Your own runs keep config values while you relax a rule (and so does any unit you are in).
sup.controls.empty_text: An admin switches them on in Admin UI -> Permissions -> Mission controls.
sup.controls.server_wide_note: This control is server-wide: the change applies to every department.
sup.controls.reset_done: {control} is back to the config value
err.happy_hour_running: A happy hour is already running.
err.happy_hour_used: Today's happy hour has been used. Try again tomorrow.
mc.control_desc.happyHour: For the minutes picked no mission has a cooldown for anyone on the server; the no-repeat rule can go off too. The abandon cooldown and the caps stay. Once a day for supervisors.
hh.banner: Happy hour: no mission cooldowns for
hh.banner_norepeat: The no-repeat rule is off too.
hh.banner_self: It does not apply to you or a unit you are in: you started it.
sup.hh.norepeat: Also switch the no-repeat rule off
sup.hh.used_up: Today's happy hour has been used.
sup.hh.confirm_text: No mission cooldowns for anyone on the server until it ends. You keep your own cooldowns.
sup.hh.confirm_end_text: Mission cooldowns count again at once for everyone.
err.sup_clear_used: You have used all your cooldown clears for today.
err.sup_time_used: You have added time to missions as often as you may today.
mc.control_desc.clearCooldown: Supervisors clear one mission or mission type cooldown of an officer of any department from Department Report. Each officer still has at most the admin's daily clears, by all staff together.
mc.control.addRunTime: Add time to a live mission
mc.control_desc.addRunTime: Supervisors add minutes (min to max per click) to a running mission of their own department from Live Missions. The fast-finish bonus is still judged on the original time limit.
admin.perms.mc.time_total: At most {minutes} min per mission in all (Settings)
sup.notice.cooldowns_cleared: A supervisor cleared one of your mission cooldowns.
sup.notice.time_added: A supervisor added {minutes} minutes to your mission timer.
sup.cd.title: {name} · cooldowns
sup.cd.text: Clear one mission or mission type cooldown. The officer is told and it is in the audit log.
sup.cd.on_run: On a mission now: cooldowns can be cleared after it ends.
sup.cd.officer_used: This officer: {used} of {max} clears used today (all staff)
sup.live.add_time_text: Adds minutes to the mission timer. The fast-finish bonus is still judged on the original time limit.
sup.live.add_time_left: Up to {left} more minutes may be added to this mission; you have {n} additions left today.
mc.control_desc.startTimeout: Seconds a unit of your department has after accepting to reach the start. Set when the run is accepted, so a change never moves a run already going.
mc.control_desc.readyCheck: Seconds a unit led by your department has to answer the ready check. Off skips the ready check, only while an admin allows it.
mc.control_desc.timeLimit: Multiplies the mission's time limit for runs of your department. The fast-finish bonus still uses the unscaled limit.
mc.control_desc.idleCheck: Seconds after a run of your department starts before officers who never reached the start are removed (with the usual idle result). Only stricter than the config.
admin.perms.mc.flag.canTurnOff: Supervisors may switch the ready check off
